== Biography ==
{{African-American Sticker}}

Jacob was born in 1830. He is the son of [[Glasgow-3823|Samuel Glasgow]] and [[Glasgow-3824|Elizabeth Glasgow]].


== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-3823]] is assessed at 89% (probable). Jacob's 1830 birth and 1850 entry in the Samuel/Elizabeth household fit Samuel's 1804 generation. His 1860 household with Jesse supplies an additional sibling bridge, but no early census relationship column exists.

Selected Glasgow-3823 fatherhood of Glasgow-3825; maternal identity and upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Compare original 1850 group with Jacob's death parents.

Source basis already held: [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:M4HM-J4K "United States, Census, 1850", FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:M4HM-J4K : Tue Jan 14 03:08:39 UTC 2025), Entry for Samuel Glasgo and Elizabeth Glasgo, 1850.]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
